question: Which of the following beaches was NOT awarded the international ‘Blue Flag’ certification by Foundation of Environment Education, Denmark as of October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Talasari.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Talasari beach was not awarded the international **‘Blue Flag’ **certification by the Foundation of Environment Education, Denmark as of **October 2020.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Blue Flag programme is operated under the auspices of the** Foundation for Environmental Education.**
 
• It is **headquartered** in Copenhagen, Denmark.
 
• India becomes the first nation to be awarded Blue Flag certification for **10 beaches** in a single attempt.
 
• **10 of India's beaches including Shivrajpur (Dwarka-Gujarat), Ghoghla (Diu), Kasarkod and Padubidri (Karnataka), Kappad (Kerala), Rushikonda (AP), Golden Beach (Odisha), Radhanagar (A&N Islands), **K**ovalam in Tamil Nadu and Eden in Puducherry** **beaches have received this award.**
 
• Blue Flag is an iconic voluntary award for beaches, marinas, and sustainable boating.
 
• It is awarded to those that** meet and maintain the criteria of a series of stringent environmental, educational, safety, and accessibility.**
